column1: # The checks of shell/callback-forms.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# list-questions, show-ifr and get --no-efivars call no Callback()
# get runs FORM_OPEN, RETRIEVE, FORM_CLOSE between two reads of the stores, which leave out
# byte 4 of the Buffer store, whose ExtractConfig() answer changes at every call

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "Off <not compared, as they changed between two reads before the first Callback(): VARSTORE 0x0002 CallbackBuffer: OFFSET=0004&WIDTH=0001>"
^callback-forms: Callback\(RETRIEVE\) question 0x0201 value 0x0: SUCCESS, returned 0x0, request 0$

column1: # set runs CHANGING and CHANGED, then reads the value back; the stores stay

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "On <applied; not compared, as they changed between two reads before the first Callback(): VARSTORE 0x0002 CallbackBuffer: OFFSET=0004&WIDTH=0001>"
^callback-forms: Callback\(RETRIEVE\) question 0x0201 value 0x1: SUCCESS, returned 0x1, request 0$

column1: # a CHANGED that overwrites the EFI variable store is not applied, and the store is restored

column3: .error_message | contains("not applied: the Callback sequence changed stores of the FormSet: VARSTORE_EFI 0x0001 CallbackStore-de145b29-c3cd-455f-91de-a76237b67c52; restored and verified; the driver's Callback(FORM_CLOSE) had already run, and any effect outside the FormSet's stores stays")

column1: # one that overwrites the Buffer store's setting has the whole store routed back in one
# RouteConfig(): that setting as before the Callback()s, the changing byte 4 as after them

column3: .error_message | contains("not applied: the Callback sequence changed stores of the FormSet: VARSTORE 0x0002 CallbackBuffer; restored and verified; ")

column1: # CHANGING's error refuses the value, and CHANGED is not sent

column3: .error_message | contains("not applied: its driver's CallBack(EFI_BROWSER_ACTION_CHANGING) refused the value: EFI_ACCESS_DENIED; the driver's Callback(FORM_CLOSE) had already run")
.error_message | contains("not applied: Callback(CHANGED) returned EFI_DEVICE_ERROR; the driver's Callback(FORM_CLOSE) had already run")

column1: # a save request in a form set with stores is not applied

column3: .error_message | contains("not applied: Callback(CHANGED) asked the forms browser to save the FormSet's modified values (EFI_BROWSER_ACTION_REQUEST_SUBMIT), which only a forms browser's edit buffer holds; ")

column1: # a reconnection request disconnects and connects the driver's handle

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("On <applied; reconnected the driver's controller (EFI_BROWSER_ACTION_REQUEST_RECONNECT); "))

column1: # the read-back tells a transient value and one that no RETRIEVE gives

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("On <applied; the driver now reports Off; "))
.responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("On <applied; the driver offers no read-back; "))

column1: # get of a question whose RETRIEVE returns EFI_UNSUPPORTED has no value

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its driver's CallBack(EFI_BROWSER_ACTION_RETRIEVE) returned EFI_UNSUPPORTED; without a VarStore the question has no other value (UEFI 2.11 "))

column1: # a reset request is noted, in a form set without stores

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "On <applied; Callback(CHANGED) asks for a platform reset (EFI_BROWSER_ACTION_REQUEST_RESET)>"

column1: # a store that ExtractConfig() does not answer refuses before any Callback()

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: cannot snapshot store VARSTORE 0x0003 CallbackUnreachable: ExtractConfig() returned EFI_NOT_FOUND"))
.error_message | contains("cannot snapshot store VARSTORE 0x0003 CallbackUnreachable: ExtractConfig() returned EFI_NOT_FOUND")

column1: # a package list that no driver handle registered has no Callback() to call

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: question has no VarStore, and no driver handle of its package list has EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL") and endswith(": GetPackageListHandle() names no driver handle>"))
.error_message | contains("no driver handle of its package list has EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL") and contains(": GetPackageListHandle() names no driver handle")
